item.description:
Mission Control Plus v1.30

  • New: a welcome checklist that walks you through Accessibility access and Open at Login
  • Easier setup: drag Mission Control Plus straight into the Accessibility list in System Settings
  • Open at Login now uses macOS's modern login items
  • Now in German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Ukrainian
  • Fixed: an extra icon next to Quit on macOS 26
